question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

She has written many books.

options.text: Many books were being written by her.
Many books have been written by her.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Many books have been written by her**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **Present Perfect Tense** and in **Active voice**.
 
• The **rule **for changing a sentence in **Present Perfect Tense** From **Active Voice to Passive Voice**:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The helping verb comes before the object in the passsive voice as the passive voice starts with the object of the active voice.
 
• Convert the verb into past participle or 3rd form of the verb.
 
• **Structure: Subject + has/have + V3 + Object (Active Voice)**
 
 

** Object + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject (Passive Voice)**

 
• **Solution**: *She has written many books. (Active Voice)*

* Many books have been written by her. (Passive Voice)*

 
• Therefore the **correct answer** is '**Many books were written by her**.'
